title: Catalog filtering and sorting
difficulty_rationale: One new function in one file with a fully specified signature; requires combining filters and a deterministic multi-key sort.
summary: Implement search_products() with optional filters, sort keys, deterministic tie-breaking and input validation.
required_behavior: Filters (all optional, combined with AND): category (exact, case-insensitive), min_price and max_price (inclusive), in_stock (True => stock > 0, False => stock == 0).
sort_by is one of 'name', 'price', 'rating'; name sorting is case-insensitive.
Ties are broken by product id ascending regardless of the descending flag.
descending=True reverses the primary sort key only.
Invalid sort_by, negative prices, or min_price > max_price raise ValueError.
The input list is never mutated; a new list is returned.

acceptance_tests.description: Default call returns all products sorted by name case-insensitively.
Descending price with id ascending tie-break.
Input list order is unchanged and a new list is returned.
